posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared her May photo dump with a rare glimpse of baby Vihaan and Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday celebrations, sending fans into a frenzy.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit announced a historic Wembley Stadium show on September 12, becoming the first South Asian artist to headline the iconic London venue.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's spy thriller Alpha may prepone to July 3 for a longer box office run. She's also joined the cast of Tumbbad 2 in a pivotal role.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirmed six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's mega-budget Varanasi alongside Mahesh Babu, including an Antarctica schedule.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's King is confirmed for Christmas 2026 with a star-studded cast. He declined Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 cameo to protect his look exclusivity for King.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan in Raj & DK's superhero film and has Meghna Gulzar's thriller Daayra with Prithviraj lined up.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Mahavatar, playing Lord Parashurama's grand mythological drama for Maddock Films.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika officially joined Allu Arjun's mega-budget Raaka with director Atlee and was spotted at a family wedding in Goa doing Orry's viral signature pose.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's post-apocalyptic thriller Pralay with a ₹300 crore budget begins shooting in August 2026 with AI-driven visuals and actress Kalyani Priyadarshan.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya was named JW Marriott's Global Brand Ambassador and turned heads at Cannes 2026 with an iconic sindoor-and-saree look paying homage to her 2002 debut.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 trailer with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon drops to massive buzz. She also shared adorable pics from her Japan honeymoon with Vijay Deverakonda.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is set to play a princess opposite Ayushmann Khurrana's vampire in Maddock Films' horror-comedy, marking her Bollywood debut with director Amar Kaushik.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's ₹600 crore sci-fi epic Raaka with director Atlee begins a major schedule mid-June, with VFX-heavy sequences already pre-filmed using cutting-edge virtual production.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports action drama Peddi hits theaters June 4 with AR Rahman's music. The film's North America advance bookings have crossed the $1 million milestone.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Bollywood debut War 2 with Hrithik Roshan is confirmed for IMAX release on August 14. The epic dance-off between the two superstars is generating massive hype.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in Peddi, the sports action drama releasing June 4. She's also part of Allu Arjun and Atlee's ambitious sci-fi Raaka.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's Chand Mera Dil has crossed ₹18 crore in its first week. Her fusion Bharatanatyam performance has gone viral and sparked a nationwide debate online.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stars alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in War 2, the YRF Spy Universe's biggest film yet, confirmed for IMAX release on August 14.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's War 2 locks August 14 IMAX release alongside Jr NTR and Kiara Advani. He's also making his directorial debut with Krrish 4 starring Priyanka Chopra.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde releases June 5, his fourth collaboration with father-director David Dhawan.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released her heartfelt new song Siddha Bhajo, her father's favorite. She's gearing up for The Unstoppable Tour across Australia, the US, and Canada.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's Peddi soundtrack is a chartbuster with Chikiri Chikiri crossing 200M YouTube views. His latest track Massa Massa is now the talk of the town.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's swan song Jana Nayagan was leaked online, sparking industry-wide condemnation from Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan. The film targets a June-July theatrical release.
